newsitem.title: UK: Saudi Arabia seen closer to barley purchase.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia seen closer to barley purchase.

text.p: Saudi Arabia is close to buying barley in its tender for 500,000 tonnes, launched on Tuesday, European grain traders said on Wednesday.
Two traders said there were unofficial indications of the results but declined to go further until the sale was finalised.
Traders said the sale would be priced at around $152 and above.
The tender was for 500,000 tonnes of barley of optional origin for delivery from the second half of April, European grain traders said on Monday.
